en: Colorized panorama of a small European town seen from a green meadow in the foreground. Trees and hedges lead toward a cluster of traditional houses with gabled roofs and some half-timbered buildings. Dominating the skyline is a tall church with a pointed spire, and additional steeples and chimneys are visible in the distance. The sky is lightly clouded with a warm hue near the horizon. The word "Geringswalde" is printed at the top center.
